extraction.title: Mid-life crisis
extraction.subtitle: From Allbirds to Glossier, millennial brands have lost their mojo They have been squeezed by competitors old and new
extraction.summary: Millennial brands like Allbirds and Glossier are struggling as competition increases and customer acquisition costs rise. Allbirds plans to pivot to AI infrastructure after losing 99% of its market value since its peak. Other brands face similar challenges, with many unable to sustain their initial growth.

events.event_summary: Allbirds lost 99% of its market value since its peak.
Casper was taken private after losing around 70% of its value.
Unilever sold a majority stake of Dollar Shave Club to a private-equity firm.
Rhode was founded by Hailey Bieber.
Glossier attempted to sell itself but could not find a buyer.
